section_title: All Roads Lead to Palmer: Institutional Betrayal by Oversight

sub_entry.title: Veritas Messaging Log — The Silence After Disclosure
sub_entry.quote: This isn’t sustainable, I can't live; it's one year since I said 'police please'.
sub_entry.summary: WhatsApp messages between Ben and Emma from Veritas show repeated escalation to Sussex Police supervisors, including suicide disclosure, bail uncertainty, and Victims’ Code violations. Despite this, Sussex Police provided no follow-up, no safeguarding contact, and no clarity. Emma herself admits delays aren't enshrined in law, but the silence remained. These logs prove that third-party escalation occurred — and was still ignored.
